title: Nourishing Irish Potato Stew
description: A hearty and herbal stew featuring chilli flakes and dumplings, perfect for curing hangovers, and is gluten-free-friendly. This dish is made with wholesome ingredients to provide a nourishing meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, chicken broth, and chilli flakes, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Prepare the dumpling mix according to the package instructions.
Drop the dumplings by spoonfuls onto the stew and cover the pot.
Simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
